authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The complete week expression is eight + days. Turner’s eight paradigm and dina supply the two members; the traditional eight-day/inclusive reckoning is independently supported by Turner *aṣṭavāra week. The spelling of eight varies in the surveys and is retained; the response is not recast as seven days.
